impact.text: Direct theft of all accumulated builder fees with no preconditions required.

precondition_sources.text: BuilderFactory owner deploys a BuilderWallet with a legitimate builderAdmin set atomically after deployment.
Protocol fees accumulate in the BuilderWallet over time as it is used as a fee recipient.

intent_sources.text: init() must be callable only once, so the builderAdmin set at deployment cannot be overwritten by a later call.
If admin rotation is a desired feature, calls that change the admin must be restricted to the current admin.
